title: Engram Memory Network: Brain-Inspired Prototype Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2610.27770v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making. In response, prototype-based models in explainable AI have attracted growing attention for their ability to retrieve visually similar examples as faithful explanations. Although these models achieve competitive classification accuracy, they often exhibit degraded explanation quality across datasets with varying characteristics, limiting their practical applicability. We draw on insights from cognitive neuroscience, particularly the human memory system, which encodes input-relevant information into representations that support recognition. We propose an Engram Memory Network (EMN), a model that emulates the ventral visual stream and inferior temporal cortex in the human brain. tldr: 该论文受人类记忆系统启发，提出了模拟大脑腹侧视觉流和下颞叶皮层的印记记忆网络（EMN），其核心是一个受Hopfield启发的记忆模块，通过迭代检索代表性原型，在保持分类准确率的同时提升了可解释AI在不同数据集上的解释质量。
